changelog: Diagnose: v3.14.2 shipped and the same real Position History paste failed with the identical error -- two releases in a row had now fixed this exact failure from reasoning about a plausible cause rather than the real failing bytes, and neither held. Investigated read-only: confirmed PCRE's \s under bf_clean_line()'s existing /u-flagged regex already matches every Unicode whitespace character (NBSP, narrow NBSP, figure/thin/en space, ideographic space, even the line separator U+2028), so v3.14.2's explicit NBSP/ZWSP/BOM list was largely redundant with code already in the file -- if the real defect were any whitespace-shaped character, it was already handled before v3.14.2 shipped. Also confirmed the premise that line 19 is Realized PnL% was never checked against real paste bytes -- it originates from a hand-counted chat sample used to write the v3.14.1 format documentation

Add: the ambiguous-leftover error in parsePositionHistory() now includes, per unrecognized line, a hex dump of both its raw (pre-bf_clean_line) and cleaned bytes alongside the visible text -- so the next real paste that hits this error is self-diagnosing instead of producing another round of inference. bf_hex() is diagnostic-only, never used in any comparison, so it cannot change parsing behavior. No change to matching logic, label set, or bf_clean_line() itself

Document, deliberately leave unfixed: bf_clean_line()'s preg_replace(...,'/u',...) calls return null on genuinely invalid UTF-8 and silently fall back to the original uncleaned line via '?? $l' -- a real defect, but evidence (json_decode's all-or-nothing UTF-8 validation in jsonInput() would produce a different error -- 'Paste Bitfunded's Position History into Box 1 first' -- if the payload were ever invalid UTF-8) points away from it as the cause of the currently observed failure. Recorded in CLAUDE.md v3.14.3 rather than fixed speculatively
